facts.text: Undergraduate students qualify for the Presbyterian Promise Scholarship by indicating membership in a Presbyterian church or attendance at a Presbyterian secondary school, receiving at least $24,000 per year.

sources.title: Presbyterian Promise Scholarship | Presbyterian College
sources.quote: New incoming undergraduate students qualify for the Presbyterian Promise Scholarship by indicating their membership in a Presbyterian church, or their attendance at a Presbyterian secondary school, on their application.
